name: Runemaster Earth Engraving grants its proc aura and procs Weapon Engraving: Earth damage
contract: Weapon Engraving: Earth 653218 puts temporary enchant 1002 on the weapon; its equip spell (type 3) is Earth
Engraving 653219, a dummy and a zero spell modifier whose description reads 'Your direct damage has a
$653221h% chance to deal ... Nature damage to enemies within $653272a1 yds of your target.' The proc belongs to
653221 ('Passive2', aura 42 triggering 653272, ProcChance 15, ProcFlags 0), which nothing applied, so the
engraving never dealt damage and Earthen Fists 806982 (+10 proc chance per stack on family 38 mask2 0x2000000,
only 653221), Stone Savant and Steam Conjurer had nothing to act on. 653219 is applied as a fixture aura (the
scenario format has no item target for cast). Expected: 653219 brings 653221; with Earthen Fists at 5 stacks
(15 -> 65%) landed auto attacks proc 653272 on the target (about 13 swings over 18 sec, so no proc has
probability 0.35^13 < 2e-6); removing 653219 removes 653221 and no further 653272 follows.
